To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the developed FI-μ-Spe technique based on electrospinning of PANI nanofiber is a promising and efficient approach for extraction of triazines and other polar organic compounds from aqueous samples.
the electrospun PANI nanofibers are a promising sorbent for the removal and preconcentration of some selected triazine compounds from water samples.
the proposed method is fast, sensitive and efficient and can be used for the extraction of triazine herbicides from aqueous media.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel, fast and efficient FI-μ-SPI system based on an electro spun PANI nanocomposite for the extraction of triazines from aqueous samples.
the development of a novel FI-μ-SP technique based on a PANI-based nanofiber for the extraction of triazines from water samples.
the synthesis of a novel electrospun PANI nanocomposite and its application in FI-μ-SPEC-GC-MS analysis of selected triazine compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FI-μ-SPI technique based on the electrospun PANI nanocomposite was a simple and rapid technique for the extraction of the triazines from aqueous samples.
the developed FI-μ-Spe-GC-MS system could be used as a powerful analytical tool in the field of environmental analysis.
the developed FI-μ-SP method could be used for the determination of the selected triazines in various environmental matrices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be successfully applied for determination of the target analytes in real water samples with high accuracy and precision.

the developed FI-μ-SPIE method based on the electrospun PANI nanofibrous sorbent could be considered as an effective tool for the determination of trace amounts of some triazines from environmental matrices.

the electrospun PANI nanocomposite is a promising material for the extraction of triazine herbicides from water matrices and the developed FI-μ-SFE technique is an efficient tool for the determination of trace levels of triazine herbicide residues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electrospun PANI nanofibrous sorbent can be used in FI-μ-SPI for the extraction of triazines from aqueous samples prior to GC-MS analysis.
the proposed PANI-based nanofibrous material can be used as a new μ-SPE sorbent in the field of water analysis.
the prepared nanofiber can serve as a new sorbent for FI-μ-SPEC of triazines in water samples.
